title: NitroStack: Build AI backends that give AI models real tools and data
description:
NitroStack is a TypeScript framework for building, testing, and deploying production-ready MCP servers. It uses decorators, built-in auth, and React widgets to make AI backends fast and easy. Scaffold a project in one command.
